review_candidates.description: About The Role We are seeking a highly motivated, professional, and customer-focused Customer Service Representative to join our remote customer support team. In this role, you will serve as a primary point of contact for customers, helping them resolve questions, address concerns, navigate our products or services, and have a positive overall experience with the company. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator who enjoys helping people, remains calm under pressure, and can efficiently manage multiple customer inquiries while maintaining a friendly and professional approach. As a remote team member, you will be expected to work independently, manage your time effectively, communicate consistently with colleagues, and maintain a high standard of customer service without direct supervision. Key Responsibilities Customer Support Respond promptly and professionally to customer inquiries through phone, email, live chat, and other support channels. Provide accurate information about products, services, policies, orders, accounts, billing, and company procedures. Listen carefully to customers, understand their needs, and provide appropriate solutions. Troubleshoot customer issues and guide customers through step-by-step solutions when necessary. Resolve complaints and difficult situations with patience, empathy, and professionalism. Escalate complex, sensitive, or unresolved issues to the appropriate department or supervisor. Follow up with customers when additional information or action is required. Ensure customers receive clear and complete answers to their questions. Customer Experience Build positive relationships with customers through helpful, respectful, and personalized interactions. Maintain a customer-first approach in every interaction. Demonstrate empathy and understanding when handling frustrated or dissatisfied customers. Identify opportunities to improve the customer experience and communicate recurring issues to management. Help customers understand company policies and procedures while maintaining a positive tone. Strive to resolve customer issues efficiently and effectively during the initial interaction whenever possible. Administrative Technical Duties Accurately document customer interactions, requests, complaints, and resolutions in the company's CRM or customer support system. Update customer account information and records as needed. Process orders, returns, refunds, cancellations, payments, or service requests according to company policies. Maintain detailed and accurate records of customer communications. Monitor support tickets and ensure requests are addressed within established response times. Use internal knowledge bases, support tools, and company resources to find accurate answers. Collaborate with sales, billing, technical support, operations, and other departments to resolve customer issues. Protect customer information and follow all applicable privacy, security, and confidentiality procedures. Remote Work Responsibilities Maintain a reliable internet connection and an appropriate workspace suitable for professional customer interactions. Be available and responsive during scheduled working hours. Attend virtual team meetings, training sessions, and coaching sessions. Communicate effectively with managers and team members using email, messaging platforms, video conferencing, and other remote collaboration tools. Manage workload and priorities independently while meeting established deadlines and service-level expectations. Demonstrate strong self-discipline, accountability, and time-management skills. Required Qualifications High school diploma or equivalent; additional education or relevant training is a plus. Previous customer service, call center, retail, hospitality, administrative, sales support, or related experience preferred. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Strong active-listening and problem-solving abilities. Comfortable communicating with customers from diverse backgrounds. Strong attention to detail and organizational skills. Ability to remain professional and composed when dealing with challenging customers or high-pressure situations. Ability to learn new products, services, systems, and procedures quickly. Basic computer proficiency and familiarity with email, web applications, CRM systems, and office software. Ability to work independently in a remote environment. Reliable attendance and ability to adhere to scheduled working hours. Preferred Qualifications 1–3 years of experience in customer service or a related role. Experience working in a remote or hybrid customer support environment. Experience using CRM, help-desk, ticketing, or live-chat platforms. Experience handling high volumes of customer inquiries. Familiarity with customer service metrics such as response time, resolution time, customer satisfaction (CSAT), and first-contact resolution. Experience supporting customers by phone, email, and live chat. Multilingual or bilingual communication skills are an advantage, depending on the company's customer base. Key Skills Competencies Communication: Clearly and professionally communicate information to customers and colleagues through written and verbal channels. Empathy: Understand customers' concerns and respond with patience, understanding, and genuine willingness to help. Problem Solving: Analyze customer issues, identify practical solutions, and know when to escalate matters. Patience Professionalism: Remain calm, respectful, and solution-oriented, particularly when dealing with frustrated customers. Attention to Detail: Accurately record customer information, follow procedures, and avoid errors when processing requests. Time Management: Efficiently prioritize multiple customer requests while meeting response and resolution targets. Adaptability: Quickly learn new products, systems, policies, and processes as the business evolves. Teamwork: Work effectively with remote colleagues and other departments to deliver consistent customer experiences. Accountability: Take ownership of customer issues and follow through until they are resolved or appropriately transferred. Technology Skills: Comfortably navigate multiple software applications and digital communication tools while assisting customers. Performance Expectations Success in this position may be measured using a combination of customer service and operational performance indicators, including: Customer satisfaction (CSAT) First-contact resolution rate Average response time Average handling time, where applicable Ticket resolution time Quality assurance scores Customer retention or loyalty indicators Accuracy of customer records and transactions Attendance and schedule adherence Individual productivity and service-level performance Working Environment This is a fully remote position . The successful candidate should be comfortable working independently while remaining an active and engaged member of a distributed team. The role may involve extended periods of computer use and frequent communication with customers through telephone, email, chat, or video-based systems. Depending on business requirements, employees may occasionally be required to work evenings, weekends, holidays, or rotating shifts. What We Offer Depending On The Company's Benefits Structure, Employees May Receive Competitive salary or hourly compensation Flexible or remote work arrangements Paid training and onboarding Career development and advancement opportunities Performance incentives or bonuses Paid time off Health, dental, and/or vision benefits Retirement or pension benefits Employee assistance programs Professional development and training opportunities Supportive and collaborative remote-work culture Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate is someone who genuinely enjoys helping others and takes pride in providing excellent customer experiences. You are dependable, patient, organized, and comfortable handling a variety of customer situations. You don't necessarily need to know everything on your first day. What matters most is your willingness to learn, your ability to communicate clearly, your commitment to solving problems, and your ability to treat every customer with respect. You should be comfortable asking questions, taking ownership of your responsibilities, learning from feedback, and working independently while staying connected with a remote team. Equal Opportunity Statement We are committed to creating an inclusive and respectful workplace. We welcome qualified applicants from diverse backgrounds and make employment decisions based on qualifications, skills, experience, and business needs, without discrimination or harassment.

review_candidates.description: Job Description Tiered Approach In Line With The Commitment To Safeguard Capacity And Support Personnel Already In The Organization, a Majority Of UNDP UNCDF/UNV Vacancies Are Advertised Using a Tiered Application Process Whereby Tier 0: UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments, whose posts will be abolished, or contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026. Background UNDP is committed to achieving workforce diversity in terms of gender, nationality, and culture. Individuals from minority groups, indigenous groups and persons with disabilities are equally encouraged to apply. All applications will be treated with the strictest confidence. UNDP does not tolerate sexual exploitation and abuse, any kind of harassment, including sexual harassment, and discrimination. All selected candidates will, therefore, undergo rigorous reference and background checks. UNDP is the leading United Nations organization in fighting to end the injustice of poverty, inequality, and climate change. Working with our broad network of experts and partners in 170 countries, we help nations to build integrated, lasting solutions for people and planet. Learn more at undp.org or follow at @UNDP. UNDP Is The Lead United Nations Agency Driving Sustainable Development And Climate Action Across The Globe. Through Its Global Policy Network (GPN), UNDP Provides Integrated Policy And Programmatic Support To Governments In Their Pursuit Of The Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). Within This Framework, The UNDP Sub-Regional Hub For West And Central Africa (UNDP WACA), Based In Dakar, Senegal, Serves As a Key Enabler Of UNDP’s Mission To Accelerate The SDGs Across 24 Countries. From Fragile And Conflict-affected Contexts To Middle-income Economies, UNDP WACA Provides Targeted Policy Advice, Technical Expertise, And Programmatic Support Tailored To National And Regional Priorities. By Focusing On Driving Impact Across Governance, Peacebuilding, Stabilization, Climate Action, Resilience, Youth Empowerment, Livelihoods, Natural Resource Management And Inclusive Growth, UNDP WACA Works At The Intersection Of Development And Crisis Response In The Region. Through Strategic Partnerships, Innovative Solutions, And Capacity-strengthening Initiatives, UNDP WACA Supports Countries And Regional Actors To Deliver Results That Secure Peace, Empower Communities, Protect The Planet And Foster Prosperity. Within The Hub, The Climate Action, Disaster Risk Reduction, Resilience And Energy Portfolio Focuses On Various Regional Programmes And Projects In The Following Areas Disaster Risk Reduction and Climate Change Adaptation Climate Security Risk Information, Early Warning and Preparedness Crisis Response, and Recovery Just transition to renewable energy Natural Resource Management To operationalize this vision, the Climate Action, Disaster Risk Reduction, Resilience and Energy Portfolio provides technical assistance, capacity building, governance reform, and knowledge sharing to support partner countries in establishing robust frameworks for carbon market participation. This work is implemented against the backdrop of a rapidly evolving development finance landscape, where traditional donor aid is increasingly being complemented or replaced by results-based payment schemes that reward verified climate outcomes. UNDP has positioned itself at the forefront of this shift through the implementation of its Policy on Performance-Based Payments (PBP), in effect since 2018. Building on its early success within the forest and climate portfolio, UNDP is scaling the PBP approach to expand access to carbon finance in a way that prioritizes environmental integrity, equity, and alignment with national development goals. In the Congo Basin region, UNDP is significantly expanding its portfolio of carbon market and results-based payment (RBP) initiatives. This includes country readiness for accessing REDD+ results-based payment mechanisms, the development of PES initiatives, support for establishing national frameworks conducive to carbon market development, and assistance in the design of jurisdictional REDD+ projects. In this context, the Carbon Market Specialist will work with the team of resilience, climate action and disaster risk reduction of UNDP Sub regional Office of for West and Central Africa to support the implementation of a regional initiative entlited “Scaling up carbon finance to preserve the Congo Basin Forests” covering five countries: Cameroon, Central African Republic (CAR), Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), Gabon, Republic of Congo. The Specialist will contribute to regional technical coordination, strengthen partnerships, and provide hands-on support to countries in designing, financing, and scaling high-integrity carbon initiatives that align with national climate priorities. Duties And Responsibilities Scope of Work – Carbon Market Analyst The Analyst will provide strategic, technical, and policy support to strengthen the enabling environment for carbon markets in the Congo Basin, promote cooperation under Article 6 of the Paris Agreement, and support countries in mobilizing carbon finance to advance sustainable development and climate action. The Analyst will be responsible for the following key areas of work: Strengthen the Enabling Environment for Carbon Markets and Article 6 Cooperation Advise governments on the development of carbon market strategies, operational guidelines, and institutional coordination mechanisms consistent with international best practices. Promote the harmonization of regional approaches, policies, and institutional frameworks for carbon market development across the Congo Basin and Central Africa. Support the integration of carbon finance and carbon market concepts into the curricula of regional academic and research institutions. Support the Development of Carbon Credit Projects and Carbon Market Transactions Provide technical advice on the identification, development, and implementation of high-quality carbon credit projects across the Congo Basin. Support Country Office in the preparation of jurisdictional and sectoral carbon market programmes, including REDD+ initiatives, in line with internationally recognized standards and methodologies. Assist governments in establishing jurisdictional Forest Reference Emission Levels (FRELs) and other technical requirements necessary for REDD+ implementation. Support the preparation of transaction-ready REDD+ investment programmes aligned with internationally recognized carbon certification standards. Facilitate engagement with private-sector partners, including international investors and Japanese private-sector entities, to promote investment in carbon projects and the transfer of mitigation outcomes. Identify opportunities to leverage innovative carbon finance mechanisms to support sustainable forest management, biodiversity conservation, and climate resilience. Mobilize Climate and Carbon Finance Provide technical support for the design and development of carbon finance programmes and investment pipelines. Support the establishment and strengthening of national climate finance registries and systems for tracking, coordinating, and reporting climate finance and carbon market transactions. Lead or coordinate feasibility studies, technical assessments, and pre-feasibility analyses to inform the formulation of carbon finance projects. Support the preparation of concept notes and funding proposals for the Green Climate Fund (GCF), including REDD+ Results-Based Payment (RBP) proposals and other climate finance mechanisms. Facilitate stakeholder consultations and ensure the meaningful participation of governments, local communities, Indigenous Peoples, civil society organizations, development partners, and the private sector in project design and implementation. Support the preparation of the Regional Congo Basin Carbon Finance Programme and other regional investment initiatives. Knowledge Management, Coordination, and Partnerships Establish and maintain strategic partnerships with governments, regional organizations, development partners, multilateral climate funds, academic institutions, the private sector, and carbon market initiatives. Represent UNDP in relevant regional and international technical meetings, working groups, and carbon market forums. Prepare technical reports, policy briefs, knowledge products, and analytical papers on carbon markets, Article 6 implementation, REDD+, and climate finance. Monitor developments in international carbon market rules, standards, and negotiations under the UNFCCC and advise UNDP and partner countries on their implications. Contribute to programme monitoring, reporting, communications, and knowledge-sharing activities related to carbon markets and climate finance. Expected Deliverables The Carbon Market Analyst is expected to contribute to the following results: Harmonized regional frameworks and cooperation mechanisms for carbon market development across the Congo Basin. Increased pipeline of high-integrity carbon credit projects and transaction-ready REDD+ programmes. Strengthened engagement with private-sector investors and carbon market partners. Improved access to carbon finance and climate finance, including Green Climate Fund REDD+ Results-Based Payments. Strengthened climate finance tracking systems and national carbon registries. High-quality technical studies, investment proposals, and knowledge products supporting the development of carbon markets in the Congo Basin. Institutional Arrangement The Carbon Market Analyst will work under the overall supervision of the Project Manager and under the leadership of the UNDP Sub-Regional Hub for West and Central Africa (Climate Action, DRR, Resilience & Energy portfolio).
